create_client: create a Client instance to interact with the Open Catalyst Project API using a custom host and scheme
get_models: fetch the list of supported ML models from the OCP API using the Client get_models method
get_bulks: fetch the list of supported bulk materials from the OCP API using the Client get_bulks method
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: submit adsorbate slab relaxation jobs to the OCP API with a specified model and adsorbate configurations
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxations_results: fetch relaxation results for a completed system by its ID using the Client get_adsorbate_slab_relaxations_results method
